question: Will Hyperliquid (HYPE) trade above $83 at any time on September 2, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the HYPE/USD price on Kraken reaches a value strictly above $83.00 at any point during September 2, 2026 (UTC, 00:00:00–23:59:59).
- "No": Wins if the HYPE/USD price on Kraken does not reach a value strictly above $83.00 at any point during September 2, 2026 (UTC, 00:00:00–23:59:59).

Clarifications:
- "Above $83" means any traded price strictly greater than $83.00 USD; a price of exactly $83.00 does not satisfy the condition.
- The high price for the full UTC calendar day of September 2, 2026 is used to determine whether the threshold was crossed at any point during that day.
